EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) AS THE AMENDED BY THE LAND ACQUISITION
(AMENDMENT) ACT, No. 28 OF 1964
Notice under Section 7
Ref. No.: ෙකʣ/ȝාෙɢ/ඉඅƮ/3/82/UDA.

I, hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following lands/servitudes which is required for a public purpose.

Description of the lands/servitudes to be acquired: Fourteen (14) allotments of land in Extent of 5.1732 Hectare depicted as Lot Nos. 1-6, 8 1/2, 8 2/2 and 9-14 in PP Co, 7766 dated 29.07.2016 prepared by Senior Superintendent of Surveys - Colombo District situated at Ward No. 6 Bloemendhal and Ward No. 7 Madampitiya within the Municipal Council limits of Colombo in Divisional Secretary’s Division of Colombo in the District of Colombo, Western Province.

All persons interested in the aforesaid lands/servitudes are hereby required to appear personally or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at the Colombo Divisional Secretariat on the 08th day of February, 2017 at 10.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 03rd day of February, 2017 the nature of their interests in the land/lands, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said lands/servitudes, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
D. P. WICKRAMASINGHE, Divisional Secretary, Colombo.
